reconstructed: WRITTEN AFTER THE FACT. p2b shipped without a PRD file — docs/v2-astryx-redesign.md §10 reserved the name `prd-v2-p2b-transcript-rich.json` and left it 'planned', so the work landed with its record living only in commit messages and a dated checkpoint note (retired in the 2026-08-02 cleanup). This file reconstructs that record from the commits and from Nash's live verification runs so the `passes` flags have somewhere to live. Story IDs are the ones actually used in the commits and channel history; where p2b's planned scope shipped WITHOUT a story ID, it is recorded as such rather than given an invented one. Nothing here is a plan for future work.
description: Turn the p2a plain-text transcript into the real reading surface: fold adjacent tool activity into Astryx ChatToolCalls rollups, give messages timestamps and the AI-chat bubble treatment, and build the blocking approval card that a supervised turn stops on. Delivered on top of p2a's ChatLayout well; the gateway's permission seam already existed (v1's useAgentChat), so this is presentation plus one narrow gateway change to the ExitPlanMode detail payload.

designFile.note: docs/v2-astryx-redesign.md line 365 flagged that p2b/p2c needed their own Paper frame(s) or an explicit decision to go without. p2b went WITHOUT one — the transcript and approval card were built from the Astryx Chat kit's own patterns against RJ-0's tokens, not from a drawn frame. Recording that as the decision it turned out to be.

conventions.astryxOnly: Astryx + ui/src/v2/tokens.css only; no shadcn/Radix/Tailwind/hex. v1 renders pixel-unchanged with the flag OFF.
conventions.reuseV1: Reuse v1's data + handlers. The approval seam is v1's useAgentChat (pendingApproval / pendingApprovals / respondToApproval) surfaced through ui/src/v2/lib/useV2Chat.ts — no new socket protocol. react-markdown + remark-gfm were already dependencies (v1 ChatPane.tsx:30).
conventions.gatewayRule: Approval UI cannot be verified from jsdom — the card only exists while a turn is blocked. Verify on a THROWAWAY stack with an isolated CONAN_DATA_DIR, driving a real PLAN-mode session: claude.ts passes --allow-dangerously-skip-permissions on every launch, so an ordinary tool call raises no approval. ExitPlanMode is the reliable trigger.

userStories.title: Rich transcript — tool rollups, timestamps, bubble treatment
userStories.description: As a user, I want the transcript to read like a conversation with foldable tool activity, not a list of 'ran a tool' placeholders.
acceptanceCriteria: Adjacent tool + approval items fold into one Astryx ChatToolCalls rollup with a per-call target and expandable Input/Result detail
User prose in a filled bubble; assistant prose unbubbled; both carry a ChatMessageMetadata timestamp
--conan-chat-measure constrains the transcript and composer to one axis
Astryx + tokens only; v1 untouched; typecheck + build + vitest pass
userStories.notes: Landed in af23281. Flag left FALSE deliberately: the rollups have unit coverage and were seen incidentally during the US-604 runs, but nobody has done a browser pass against this story's own criteria. Code shipped; behaviour unproven at the story level. Do not flip without a live pass.

userStories.title: Blocking approval card for supervised turns
userStories.description: As a user, I want a turn that needs my approval to stop and ask me in the chat surface, with enough context to decide.
acceptanceCriteria: The card replaces the composer while a permission request is pending and restores it on decision
Plan-specific copy for ExitPlanMode; the four standard decisions otherwise; no session-widening on the plan card
Approving continues the SAME turn rather than starting a new one
The proposed plan is rendered INSIDE the card, not left in a collapsed tool group
Zero page errors; verified on a throwaway stack against a real plan-mode session
userStories.notes: Landed in af23281; completed by 611c894 (plan markdown rendered in the card, copy corrected from 'Review the plan above', aria-live added). VERIFIED LIVE by Nash on :3830/:5230 against an isolated CONAN_DATA_DIR: card in 21.5s, plan rendered as real markdown (6 headings / 7 paragraphs / 4 pre / 23 code), no JSON leak, composer swapped out, 'Proceed in build' restored the composer in 0.1s and the same turn continued into a genuine Write/Edit request, decline wrote 'Approval decline', zero page errors across three sessions.

userStories.title: Permission-mode chip (capability-driven)
userStories.description: As a user, I want to choose a permission mode before the first prompt, from the active provider's own vocabulary.
acceptanceCriteria: Choices come only from the active provider's capabilities.permissionModes; no provider-name branching
A fresh session defaults to the provider's own default label without sending an override
Selecting Plan sends permissionMode through the existing AgentOpts seam
The chip clears on provider switch and disappears once the session locks
userStories.notes: Landed in af23281. Not in the original p2b scope — added because without it a plan-mode session could not be started from v2 at all, which is what made US-604 testable on real traffic. Verified live as part of the US-604 run (chip label Supervised -> Plan, options from capabilities).

openFollowUps.item: Approval panel aria-live is inserted, not mutated
openFollowUps.detail: V2ChatView.tsx:113 swaps the composer OUT for the panel, so the live region is inserted rather than updated and screen readers likely never announce it; assertive+atomic would also read the whole plan. Wants a persistent polite status node plus a focus move. NOT screen-reader tested — mechanism and DOM evidence only.
